## WinBat Lens 1.1.7

- Removed unused disk performance-counter initialization and unreachable network/RAM telemetry helpers, avoiding work and native dependencies that never contributed to a displayed or recorded result.
- Preserved the consumed CPU and GPU Engine monitoring paths and added regression coverage for that boundary.
- Hardened local release packaging: a normal release build now fails when Inno Setup or the installer artifact is missing; portable-only development packages require an explicit opt-out.

The executable and installer remain unsigned unless a signing certificate is supplied to the release build.
